faq.subtitle: Answering your most common questions about our architecture, engagement model, and how we guarantee successful implementations.

questions.q: What exactly is included in custom development?
questions.a: Our approach covers the entire lifecycle: from process analysis and UI/UX design, to backend architecture, CRM/ERP integration, automations, and production deployment. We deliver a turnkey system ready to scale.

questions.q: Do you integrate with systems we already use (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)?
questions.a: Yes, we are platform agnostic. We integrate via API (REST/GraphQL) or Webhooks with any modern software your team relies on, ensuring real-time bidirectional synchronization.

questions.q: How long does it take to implement a full solution?
questions.a: It depends on the technical complexity and required integrations. A functional MVP usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while complex enterprise architectures can span 3 to 5 months. We provide a transparent roadmap from day 1.

questions.q: What happens with maintenance once the project is delivered?
questions.a: We offer continuous support SLAs. We monitor uptime 24/7, apply security patches, optimize database queries, and provide a retainer for new features.
You own 100% of the intellectual property. Upon project completion, we hand over the full repository, technical documentation, and infrastructure credentials (AWS/Vercel/DigitalOcean).

questions.q: Why work with A BLANK instead of hiring an in-house team?
questions.a: Building an in-house team takes months (recruiting, onboarding) and generates high fixed costs. We are a pre-assembled SWAT team: orchestrator, UI/UX, engineers, and DevOps working under a proven methodology, delivering results in a fraction of the time with Time-Zone Alignment (CST/EST).
